correctness.rationale: An independent enumeration of all 2^16=65,536 incoming-to-outgoing local-pairing maps in the binary de Bruijn graph produced exactly 2,048 one-cycle Eulerian circuits anchored at 00000. Explicit correlation and reversal/complement grouping yielded 526 signatures with fiber sizes 2:30,4:495,8:1; exactly 528 transform orbits 2:32,4:496; exactly two fibers contain two inequivalent orbits. Autocorrelation prefix partitions have 521 signatures through lag 12 and 526 through lag 13; all 2048 cycles were checked. The pairing bijection proves domain exhaustiveness; counts do not rely on supplied CSV or claimed VERIFY_OK output.
